options.command: if [ -n "$RUBYGEMS_PKG_VERSION" ]; then VER="${RUBYGEMS_PKG_VERSION#v}"; sed -i "s/VERSION = '[^']*'/VERSION = '$VER'/" lib/cogbox_api_client/version.rb && echo "Changed version to $VER"; else echo "Using version from version.rb"; fi

commands: yarn run openapi-generator-cli generate -i dist/apps/api/openapi.json -g ruby -t hack/ruby-client/openapi-templates --additional-properties=gemAuthor=cognifyi,gemAuthorEmail=support@pazity.com,gemDescription=\"Cogbox API Client\",gemHomepage=\"https://github.com/cognifyi/cogbox\",gemVersion=$DEFAULT_GEM_VERSION,gemName=cogbox_api_client,enumUnknownDefaultCase=true -o libs/api-client-ruby

VER=${RUBYGEMS_PKG_VERSION#v}; if [ -n "$VER" ] && gem list -r "^cogbox_api_client$" --version "$VER" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo "cogbox_api_client==$VER already on RubyGems, skipping push"; else gem push cogbox_api_client-*.gem --key rubygems --host https://rubygems.org; fi
